stages.source_locator: Main PDF p9 / printed 9430, Materials and synthesis, step 1
stages.source_statement: Dry and degas oleylamine and 1-dodecanethiol by heating under vacuum

stages.source_locator: Main PDF p9 / printed 9430, Materials and synthesis, step 2
stages.source_statement: Charge 50 mL three-neck round-bottom flask with reflux condenser with Ni(acac)2 and Co(acac)2; add degassed oleylamine
stages.uncertainty: mass/mole mismatch and ratio orientation conflict

stages.source_locator: Main PDF p9 / printed 9430, Materials and synthesis, step 3
Main PDF p9 / printed 9430, Materials and synthesis, step 4
stages.source_statement: Switch to flowing N2; raise to chosen reaction temperature; metal precursor nucleation around 155 C, colorless to black
stages.other_condition: says same rate as prior step and approx 14 C/min
stages.additional_evidence_locator: main p3/9424 (nucleation around 155 C; colorless-to-black change)

stages.source_locator: Main PDF p9 / printed 9430, Materials and synthesis, step 5
stages.source_statement: At final temperature inject degassed DDT, then hold at reaction temperature
stages.atmosphere_pressure: flowing N2 (global Methods condition; step 5 does not restate the atmosphere)
stages.other_condition: baseline narrative 180 C/2 h; optimization 2 h and 7 mL OAm
stages.uncertainty: exact per-run absolute ratio amounts absent

stages.source_locator: Main PDF p9 / printed 9430, Materials and synthesis, step 6
stages.source_statement: Remove flask from heat source and cool naturally to room temperature

stages.source_locator: Main PDF p9 / printed 9430, Materials and synthesis, step 7
stages.source_statement: In air dilute with hexanes and sonicate; split into two 50 mL tubes, fill with ethanol, centrifuge; discard supernatant; redisperse particles in hexanes and sonicate
stages.quantity_as_reported: 3-8 mL hexanes; first ethanol amount not given; 5 mL hexanes
stages.duration: sonicate 5 min; centrifuge 5 min; redisperse/sonicate 5 min

stages.source_locator: Main PDF p9 / printed 9430, Materials and synthesis, step 8
stages.source_statement: Precipitate/wash and redisperse with ethanol and acetone
stages.duration: sonication/centrifuge timing inherited as same procedure

stages.source_locator: Main PDF p9 / printed 9430, Materials and synthesis, step 9
stages.duration: sonication/centrifuge timing inherited as same procedure

stages.source_locator: Main PDF p9 / printed 9430, Materials and synthesis, step 10
stages.source_statement: Redisperse product in hexanes and sonicate
